comparison.objective: Assemble and mesh three gears on assigned shafts.
comparison.physical_skill: Peg/shaft insertion, contact-guided tooth-phase alignment, and sequential rigid-part placement.
comparison.success_condition: All gears seated, meshed, still, and both arms clear for 1 s, with partial credit for seated gears/pairs.
comparison.reason: Tests phase-sensitive assembly of individual parts, not simultaneous size-selective separation.
